## findings

1. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED — seeded order refund not producible by the order charter.** Symptom: `order_events.5d9092f7…restocking_fee_amount` 97.35, `amount` 594.27; `card_transactions.c2c90233…amount` 594.27; `purchases.5c63d8bd…net_paid_amount` 97.35. Root cause: order.yaml `order_evt_refund` fixes "The restocking fee is the class's restocking_fee_pct of the refunded merchandise (net_paid_amount minus tax_refunded)" (compute line 817) = 15% x (691.62 - 51.92) = 95.96; the seed took 15% of the unit price 649.00. Consequence: refund_basis, card_basis and fee_share read these rows; on the producible refund (595.66) the deduction is 2,195 (GT 2,189) and the reinstated note 6.52 (GT 6.51). Affected: task 1 `initial_state.order_events`, `card_transactions`, `purchases`; design_rationale asserts "restocking fee -> refund 594.27" and "97.35 / 649.00 = 0.15", true of the seed but not of the order charter. Previous revisions: none.
2. Observations: O2 (deduction sentence covers every refunded return, the condition only those that earned points; both returns here earned points); O5 (flat "The courtesy validity days are the tier courtesy days." gives 21 if read alone; the exhaustive return-share ladder governs; `compute_basis.result` quotes the flat sentence); O6 (most-recently-lapsed object rule undeclared narrowing; no effect here); O8 (event_clawback / card_clawback realism); design_rationale labels cardmember_uplift multi-source although both conditions sit on one card row (other genuine multi-source factors exist); the persona expects a "return reference" for the courtesy submission while the docstring fixes the empty value (no second value: the persona uses exactly what the agent gives).
